warnings.head: FIRST CATEGORY WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS
warnings.text: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Perak • Selangor • N. Sembilan • Melaka • Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan • Sarawak until 10:00 AM; Thursday, 26 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (FIRST CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds of 40 - 50 kmph with wave height up to 3.5 metres are expected over the waters of Northern part of Condore • Northern part of Reef North until Saturday, 28 Novemb
